messages:
Maria: Incoming external pentest scheduled 2025-10-10 -> 2025-10-12. Need owner for ephemeral RBAC, KMS key, audit export, and retest slot. Who volunteers?

pen-test-bot: Intake received: https://forms.internal/redwood-pt-intake - assessment_id: PT-2025-10-10-A

Jake: I can do ephemeral roles + assume-role workflow. Proposal: STS tokens via OIDC, TTL 1h, require session-tags assessor_id and assessor_email. Keep policy minimal.

Sara: I'll take audit exports. We need decision: stream to SIEM or copy to immutable evidence prefix. Recommend immutable S3 prefix with object-lock (90d) and an index sent to SIEM.

Kevin: KMS considerations: we should not hand external assessors decrypt. Options:
1) Assessor encrypts client-side using GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
2) Ingest service re-wraps to a vault key
This prevents giving Decrypt permissions to assessors.

Alan: Compliance checklist: chain-of-custody CSV, IAM session mapping, timestamps for each evidence file. Also require assessors sign the intake checklist before role activation.

Maria: Jake, sketch minimal IAM policy for ephemeral role (S3 Put to evidence prefix, CloudTrail ReadOnly for timeframe, sts:AssumeRole enforcement).

Jake: Draft snippet:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/PT-2025-10-10/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["cloudtrail:LookupEvents","cloudtrail:GetEventSelectors"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"ForAllValues:StringEquals":{"aws:RequestTag/assessment_id":"PT-2025-10-10"}}}
  ]
}
```
Will add session-tag requirement in trust policy.

Sara: For the evidence bucket, enable Object Lock with Governance mode 30d min and set a 90d retention hold. Also enable S3 access logging and cross-account replication to our evidence vault.

Kevin: I'll create a KMS key with key policy restricting Encrypt/Decrypt to (a) ephemeral-assessor role (only Encrypt via GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext), (b) ingest lambda. Key ARN will be posted here when created.

Maria: Incident flow: if assessors discover an active exploit, they must contact eng-oncall immediately and freeze further testing. Who is primary oncall for that window?

Jake: I'll arrange the oncall notification and schedule a pre-window 08:30 UTC check-in on 2025-10-10. Eng-oncall team please ack.

pen-test-bot: Uploaded artifact: assessment-artifacts-template -> https://storage.internal/redwood/pt-templates/assessment-artifacts-v2.json

Alan: I'll produce the chain-of-custody template and a mapping CSV that includes assessor_id, email, assume-role-arn, and photo-id hash (if provided). Compliance wants session tags enforced.

Sara: Small ops ask: enable CloudTrail Insights for the window and bump app logging to DEBUG for services in-scope. I'll open a PR to toggle levels and snapshot config before change.

Kevin: KMS flow detail I'll implement:
- Create key: alias/aws/pt-ingest-2025-10
- Grant GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext to ephemeral role
- Ingest lambda uses Decrypt to rewrap
This keeps plaintext keys off assessors' machines.

Jake: Retest proposal: reserve 2025-10-20 and 10-21 as retest days. Need 48h notice min. Security owners, confirm you can hold those slots.

Alan: Tentatively approved. Compliance: must package evidence and close chain-of-custody before retest starts.

Maria: Owners recap (due EOD today):
- Ephemeral role: Jake
- KMS key + policy: Kevin
- Audit/evidence export & object-lock: Sara
- Chain-of-custody + mapping: Alan
- Oncall coordination: Jake -> eng-oncall

Jake: I'll post the assume-role trust policy and update the internal runbook once Kevin posts KMS ARN.

Kevin: Key created: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Staging policy attached. Will paste policy in next message.

Sara: Reminder: keep retention conservative (90d) for now. If compliance requires 180d we'll extend but need sign-off.

Maria: I'll assemble intake packet and send to vendor 2025-10-02 16:00 UTC with the access window, assessor contact list, and rules of engagement. Any last blockers?

Jake: One ask: require assessors to use company-approved uploader (cli/tool) that enforces client-side encryption and attaches metadata (assessor-id, assessment_id, timestamp, sha256). I'll work with devex to provide the wrapper.

Alan: Once we have the role + key, I'll publish the final chain-of-custody and sign-off checklist.

pen-test-bot: Reminder scheduled: PT intake send at 2025-10-02 16:00 UTC.

Maria: Thanks everyone. If you can't finish EOD, reply here. :thumbsup:
